v.t: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant, to be a warning to humanity
v.l: Tabaraka Al-Ladhi Nazzala Al-Furqana `Ala `Abdihi Liyakuna Lil`alamina Nadhiraan

v.t: He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, who took to Himself no son, who never had a partner in His kingship; who created everything and determined its measure
v.l: Al-Ladhi Lahu Mulku As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Lam Yattakhidh Waladaan Wa Lam Yakun Lahu Sharikun Fi Al-Mulki Wa Khalaqa Kulla Shay'in Faqaddarahu Taqdiraan

v.t: And yet, instead of Him, they produce for themselves gods that create nothing, but are themselves created; that have no power to harm or benefit themselves; and no power over life, death, or resurrection
v.l: Wa Attakhadhu Min Dunihi 'Alihatan La Yakhluquna Shay'aan Wa Hum Yukhlaquna Wa La Yamlikuna Li'nfusihim Đarraan Wa La Naf`aan Wa La Yamlikuna Mawtaan Wa La Hayaatan Wa La Nushuraan

v.t: Those who disbelieve say, “This is nothing but a lie that he made up, and others have helped him at it.” They have committed an injustice and a perjury
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'In Hadha 'Illa 'Ifkun Aftarahu Wa 'A`anahu `Alayhi Qawmun 'Akharuna Faqad Ja'u Zulmaan Wa Zuraan

v.t: And they say, “Tales of the ancients; he wrote them down; they are dictated to him morning and evening.”
v.l: Wa Qalu 'Asatiru Al-'Awwalina Aktatabaha Fahiya Tumla `Alayhi Bukratan Wa 'Asilaan

v.t: Say, “It was revealed by He who knows the Secret in the heavens and the earth. He is always Forgiving and Merciful.”
v.l: Qul 'Anzalahu Al-Ladhi Ya`lamu As-Sirra Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Innahu Kana Ghafuraan Rahimaan

v.t: And they say, “What sort of messenger is this, who eats food, and walks in the marketplaces? If only an angel was sent down with him, to be alongside him a warner.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Mali Hadha Ar-Rasuli Ya'kulu At-Ta`ama Wa Yamshi Fi Al-'Aswaqi Lawla 'Unzila 'Ilayhi Malakun Fayakuna Ma`ahu Nadhiraan

v.t: Or, “If only a treasure was dropped on him.” Or, “If only he had a garden from which he eats.” The evildoers also say, “You are following but a man under spell.”
v.l: Aw Yulqa 'Ilayhi Kanzun 'Aw Takunu Lahu Jannatun Ya'kulu Minha Wa Qala Az-Zalimuna 'In Tattabi`una 'Illa Rajulaan Mashuraan

v.t: Look how they invent examples for you. They have gone astray, and cannot find a way
v.l: Anzur Kayfa Đarabu Laka Al-'Amthala Fađallu Fala Yastati`una Sabilaan

v.t: Blessed is He who, if He wills, can provide you with better than that—gardens beneath which rivers flow—and He will give you palaces
v.l: Tabaraka Al-Ladhi 'In Sha'a Ja`ala Laka Khayraan Min Dhalika Jannatin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Wa Yaj`al Laka Qusuraan

v.t: In fact, they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze
v.l: Bal Kadhabu Bis-Sa`ati Wa 'A`tadna Liman Kadhaba Bis-Sa`ati Sa`iraan

v.t: When it sees them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring
v.l: Idha Ra'at/hum Min Makanin Ba`idin Sami`u Laha Taghayyuzaan Wa Zafiraan

v.t: And when they are thrown into it, into a tight place, shackled, they will plead there for death
v.l: Wa 'Idha 'Ulqu Minha Makanaan Đayyiqaan Muqarranina Da`aw Hunalika Thuburaan

v.t: “Do not plead for one death today, but plead for a great many deaths.”
v.l: La Tad`u Al-Yawma Thuburaan Wahidaan Wa Ad`u Thuburaan Kathiraan

v.t: Say, “Is this better, or the Garden of Eternity promised to the righteous? It is for them a reward and a destination
v.l: Qul 'Adhalika Khayrun 'Am Jannatu Al-Khuldi Allati Wu`ida Al-Muttaquna Kanat Lahum Jaza'an Wa Masiraan

v.t: They will have therein whatever they desire, forever. That is upon your Lord a binding promise
v.l: Lahum Fiha Ma Yasha'una Khalidina Kana `Ala Rabbika Wa`daan Mas'ulaan

v.t: On the Day when He gathers them, and what they worshiped besides God, He will say, “Was it you who misled these servants of Mine, or was it they who lost the way?”
v.l: Wa Yawma Yahshuruhum Wa Ma Ya`buduna Min Duni Allahi Fayaqulu 'A'antum 'Ađlaltum `Ibadi Ha'uula' 'Am Hum Đallu As-Sabila

v.t: They will say, “Glory be to You. It was not for us to take any lords besides You. But you gave them enjoyments, and their ancestors, until they forgot the Message, and became ruined people.”
v.l: Qalu Subhanaka Ma Kana Yanbaghi Lana 'An Nattakhidha Min Dunika Min 'Awliya'a Wa Lakin Matta`tahum Wa 'Aba'ahum Hatta Nasu Adh-Dhikra Wa Kanu Qawmaan Buraan

v.t: They have denied you because of what you say; so you can neither avert, nor help. Whoever among you commits injustice, We will make him taste a grievous punishment
v.l: Faqad Kadhabukum Bima Taquluna Fama Tastati`una Sarfaan Wa La Nasraan Wa Man Yazlim Minkum Nudhiqhu `Adhabaan Kabiraan

v.t: We never sent any messengers before you, but they ate food and walked in the marketplaces. And We made some of you tempters for one another—will you be patient? Your Lord is always Observing
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Qablaka Mina Al-Mursalina 'Illa 'Innahum Laya'kuluna At-Ta`ama Wa Yamshuna Fi Al-'Aswaqi Wa Ja`alna Ba`đakum Liba`đin Fitnatan 'Atasbiruna Wa Kana Rabbuka Basiraan

v.t: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord.” They have grown arrogant within themselves, and have become excessively defiant
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina La Yarjuna Liqa'ana Lawla 'Unzila `Alayna Al-Mala'ikatu 'Aw Nara Rabbana Laqadi Astakbaru Fi 'Anfusihim Wa `Ataw `Utuwaan Kabiraan

v.t: On the Day when they see the angels—there will be no good news for sinners on that Day; and they will say, “A protective refuge.”
v.l: Yawma Yarawna Al-Mala'ikata La Bushra Yawma'idhin Lilmujrimina Wa Yaquluna Hijraan Mahjuraan

v.t: We will proceed to the works they did, and will turn them into scattered dust
v.l: Wa Qadimna 'Ila Ma `Amilu Min `Amalin Faja`alnahu Haba'an Manthuraan

v.t: The companions of Paradise on that Day will be better lodged, and more fairly accommodated
v.l: Ashabu Al-Jannati Yawma'idhin Khayrun Mustaqarraan Wa 'Ahsanu Maqilaan

v.t: The Day when the sky is cleft with clouds, and the angels are sent down in streams
v.l: Wa Yawma Tashaqqaqu As-Sama'u Bil-Ghamami Wa Nuzzila Al-Mala'ikatu Tanzilaan

v.t: On that Day, true sovereignty will belong to the Merciful, and it will be a difficult Day for the disbelievers
v.l: Al-Mulku Yawma'idhin Al-Haqqu Lilrrahmani Wa Kana Yawmaan `Ala Al-Kafirina `Asiraan

v.t: On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands, and say, “If only I had followed the way with the Messenger
v.l: Wa Yawma Ya`ađđu Az-Zalimu `Ala Yadayhi Yaqulu Ya Laytani Attakhadhtu Ma`a Ar-Rasuli Sabilaan

v.t: Oh, woe to me; I wish I never took so-and-so for a friend
v.l: Ya Waylati Laytani Lam 'Attakhidh Fulanaan Khalilaan

v.t: He led me away from the Message after it had come to me; for Satan has always been a betrayer of man.”
v.l: Laqad 'Ađallani `Ani Adh-Dhikri Ba`da 'Idh Ja'ani Wa Kana Ash-Shaytanu Lil'insani Khadhulaan

v.t: And the Messenger will say, “My Lord, my people have abandoned this Quran.”
v.l: Wa Qala Ar-Rasulu Ya Rabbi 'Inna Qawmi Attakhadhu Hadha Al-Qur'ana Mahjuraan

v.t: Likewise, to every prophet We assign enemies from among the wicked. But your Lord suffices as a Guide and Savior
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Ja`alna Likulli Nabiyin `Aduwaan Mina Al-Mujrimina Wa Kafa Birabbika Hadiaan Wa Nasiraan

v.t: Those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Quran not revealed to him at once?” Thus in order to strengthen your heart thereby, and We revealed it in stages
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lawla Nuzzila `Alayhi Al-Qur'anu Jumlatan Wahidatan Kadhalika Linuthabbita Bihi Fu'uadaka Wa Rattalnahu Tartilaan

v.t: Whatever argument they come to you with, We provide you with the truth, and a better exposition
v.l: Wa La Ya'tunaka Bimathalin 'Illa Ji'naka Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Ahsana Tafsiraan

v.t: Those who are herded into Hell on their faces—those are in a worse position, and further astray from the way
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yuhsharuna `Ala Wujuhihim 'Ila Jahannama 'Ula'ika Sharrun Makanaan Wa 'Ađallu Sabilaan

v.t: We gave Moses the Scripture, and appointed his brother Aaron as his assistant
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Al-Kitaba Wa Ja`alna Ma`ahu 'Akhahu Haruna Waziraan

v.t: We said, “Go to the people who rejected Our signs,” and We destroyed them completely
v.l: Faqulna Adh/haba 'Ila Al-Qawmi Al-Ladhina Kadhabu Bi'ayatina Fadammarnahum Tadmiraan

v.t: And the people of Noah: when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and made them a lesson for mankind. We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful retribution
v.l: Wa Qawma Nuhin Lamma Kadhabu Ar-Rusula 'Aghraqnahum Wa Ja`alnahum Lilnnasi 'Ayatan Wa 'A`tadna Lilzzalimina `Adhabaan 'Alimaan

v.t: And Aad, and Thamood, and the inhabitants of Arras, and many generations in between
v.l: Wa `Adaan Wa Thamuda Wa 'Ashaba Ar-Rassi Wa Qurunaan Bayna Dhalika Kathiraan

v.t: To each We presented the parables; and each We devastated utterly
v.l: Wa Kullaan Đarabna Lahu Al-'Amthala Wa Kullaan Tabbarna Tatbiraan

v.t: And they came upon the city that was drenched by the terrible rain. Did they not see it? But they do not expect resurrection
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Ataw `Ala Al-Qaryati Allati 'Umtirat Matara As-Saw'i 'Afalam Yakunu Yarawnaha Bal Kanu La Yarjuna Nushuraan

v.t: And when they see you, they take you for nothing but mockery: “Is this the one God sent as a messenger?”
v.l: Wa 'Idha R'awka 'In Yattakhidhunaka 'Illa Huzuan 'Ahadha Al-Ladhi Ba`atha Allahu Rasulaan

v.t: “He nearly led us away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them.” But they will know, when they witness the torment, who is further away from the way
v.l: In Kada Layuđilluna `An 'Alihatina Lawla 'An Sabarna `Alayha Wa Sawfa Ya`lamuna Hina Yarawna Al-`Adhaba Man 'Ađallu Sabilaan

v.t: Have you seen him who chose his desire as his god? Would you be an agent for him
v.l: Ara'ayta Mani Attakhadha 'Ilahahu Hawahu 'Afa'anta Takunu `Alayhi Wa Kilaan

v.t: Or do you assume that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle, but even more errant in their way
v.l: Am Tahsabu 'Anna 'Aktharahum Yasma`una 'Aw Ya`qiluna 'In Hum 'Illa Kal'an`am Bal Hum 'Ađallu Sabilaan

v.t: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shadow? Had He willed, He could have made it still. And We made the sun a pointer to it
v.l: Alam Tara 'Ila Rabbika Kayfa Madda Az-Zilla Wa Law Sha'a Laja`alahu Sakinaan Thumma Ja`alna Ash-Shamsa `Alayhi Dalilaan

v.t: Then We withdraw it towards Us gradually
v.l: Thumma Qabađnahu 'Ilayna Qabđaan Yasiraan

v.t: And it is He who made the night a covering for you, and sleep for rest; and He made the day a revival
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-Layla Libasaan Wa An-Nawma Subataan Wa Ja`ala An-Nahara Nushuraan

v.t: And it is He who sends the winds, bringing advance news of His mercy; and We send down from the sky pure water
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi 'Arsala Ar-Riyaha Bushraan Bayna Yaday Rahmatihi Wa 'Anzalna Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Tahuraan

v.t: To revive dead lands thereby, and to provide drink for the multitude of animals and humans We created
v.l: Linuhyiya Bihi Baldatan Maytaan Wa Nusqiyahu Mimma Khalaqna 'An`amaan Wa 'Anasiya Kathiraan

v.t: We have circulated it among them, that they may reflect, but most people persist in thanklessness
v.l: Wa Laqad Sarrafnahu Baynahum Liyadhakkaru Fa'aba 'Aktharu An-Nasi 'Illa Kufuraan

v.t: Had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner
v.l: Wa Law Shi'na Laba`athna Fi Kulli Qaryatin Nadhiraan

v.t: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with it, a mighty struggle
v.l: Fala Tuti`i Al-Kafirina Wa Jahid/hum Bihi Jihadaan Kabiraan

v.t: And it is He who merged the two seas; this one fresh and sweet, and that one salty and bitter; and He placed between them a barrier, and an impassable boundary
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Maraja Al-Bahrayni Hadha `Adhbun Furatun Wa Hadha Milhun 'Ujajun Wa Ja`ala Baynahuma Barzakhaan Wa Hijraan Mahjuraan

v.t: And it is He who, from fluid, created the human being. Then He made relationships through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Mina Al-Ma'i Basharaan Faja`alahu Nasabaan Wa Sihraan Wa Kana Rabbuka Qadiraan

v.t: And yet, instead of God, they serve what neither profits them nor harms them. The disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord
v.l: Wa Ya`buduna Min Duni Allahi Ma La Yanfa`uhum Wa La Yađurruhum Wa Kana Al-Kafiru `Ala Rabbihi Zahiraan

v.t: We sent you only as a herald of good news and a warner
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalnaka 'Illa Mubashiraan Wa Nadhiraan

v.t: Say, “I ask of you no payment for this—only that whoever wills may take a path to his Lord.”
v.l: Qul MA 'As'alukum `Alayhi Min 'Ajrin 'IllA Man ShA'a 'An Yattakhidha 'IlA¡ Rabbihi SabA«lAan

v.t: And put your trust in the Living, the One who never dies; and celebrate His praise. He suffices as the All-Informed Knower of the faults of His creatures
v.l: Wa Tawakkal `Ala Al-Hayyi Al-Ladhi La Yamutu Wa Sabbih Bihamdihi Wa Kafa Bihi Bidhunubi `Ibadihi Khabiraan

v.t: He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, then settled on the Throne. The Most Merciful. Ask about Him a well-informed
v.l: Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma Fi Sittati 'Ayyamin Thumma Astawa `Ala Al-`Arshi Ar-Rahmanu Fas'al Bihi Khabiraan

v.t: And when it is said to them, “Bow down to the Merciful,” they say, “And what is the Merciful? Are we to bow down to whatever you command us?” And it increases their aversion
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahum Asjudu Lilrrahmani Qalu Wa Ma Ar-Rahmanu 'Anasjudu Lima Ta'muruna Wa Zadahum Nufuraan

v.t: Blessed is He who placed constellations in the sky, and placed in it a lamp, and an illuminating moon
v.l: Tabaraka Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Fi As-Sama'i Burujaan Wa Ja`ala Fiha Sirajaan Wa Qamaraan Muniraan

v.t: And it is He who made the night and the day alternate—for whoever desires to reflect, or desires to show gratitude
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Al-Layla Wa An-Nahara Khilfatan Liman 'Arada 'An Yadhakkara 'Aw 'Arada Shukuraan

v.t: The servants of the Merciful are those who walk the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, “Peace.”
v.l: Wa `Ibadu Ar-Rahmani Al-Ladhina Yamshuna `Ala Al-'Arđi Hawnaan Wa 'Idha Khatabahumu Al-Jahiluna Qalu Salamaan

v.t: And those who pass the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing up
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yabituna Lirabbihim Sujjadaan Wa Qiyamaan

v.t: And those who say, ‘‘Our Lord, avert from us the suffering of Hell, for its suffering is continuous
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yaquluna Rabbana Asrif `Anna `Adhaba Jahannama 'Inna `Adhabaha Kana Gharamaan

v.t: It is indeed a miserable residence and destination.”
v.l: Innaha Sa'at Mustaqarraan Wa Muqamaan

v.t: And those who, when they spend, are neither wasteful nor stingy, but choose a middle course between that
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Idha 'Anfaqu Lam Yusrifu Wa Lam Yaqturu Wa Kana Bayna Dhalika Qawamaan

v.t: And those who do not implore besides God any other god, and do not kill the soul which God has made sacred—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not commit adultery. Whoever does that will face penalties
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina La Yad`una Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara Wa La Yaqtuluna An-Nafsa Allati Harrama Allahu 'Illa Bil-Haqqi Wa La Yaznuna Wa Man Yaf`al Dhalika Yalqa 'Athamaan

v.t: The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever
v.l: Yuđa`af Lahu Al-`Adhabu Yawma Al-Qiyamati Wa Yakhlud Fihi Muhanaan

v.t: Except for those who repent, and believe, and do good deeds. These—God will replace their bad deeds with good deeds. God is ever Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Illa Man Taba Wa 'Amana Wa `Amila `Amalaan Salihaan Fa'ula'ika Yubaddilu Allahu Sayyi'atihim Hasanatin Wa Kana Allahu Ghafuraan Rahimaan

v.t: Whoever repents and acts righteously—has inclined towards God with repentance
v.l: Wa Man Taba Wa `Amila Salihaan Fa'innahu Yatubu 'Ila Allahi Matabaan

v.t: And those who do not bear false witness; and when they come across indecencies, they pass by with dignity
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina La Yash/haduna Az-Zura Wa 'Idha Marru Bil-Laghwi Marru Kiramaan

v.t: And those who, when reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Idha Dhukkiru Bi'ayati Rabbihim Lam Yakhirru `Alayha Summaan Wa `Umyanaan

v.t: And those who say, “Our Lord, grant us delight in our spouses and our children, and make us a good example for the righteous.”
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Yaquluna Rabbana Hab Lana Min 'Azwajina Wa Dhurriyatina Qurrata 'A`yunin Wa Aj`alna Lilmuttaqina 'Imamaan

v.t: Those will be awarded the Chamber for their patience, and will be greeted therein with greetings and peace
v.l: Ula'ika Yujzawna Al-Ghurfata Bima Sabaru Wa Yulaqqawna Fiha Tahiyatan Wa Salamaan

v.t: Abiding therein forever—it is an excellent residence and destination
v.l: Khalidina Fiha Hasunat Mustaqarraan Wa Muqamaan

v.t: Say, “What are you to my Lord without your prayers? You have denied the truth, and the inevitable will happen.”
v.l: Qul Ma Ya`ba'u Bikum Rabbi Lawla Du`a'uukum Faqad Kadhabtum Fasawfa Yakunu Lizamaan
